name: Mina
bonusDescription: Monitors security patrols, warns you when rivals move on your walls, and makes rivals back off more often.
hint: Hangs out near the corner store.
missionDescription: Recover her blackbook from the north alley.

dialogue.meet: I'm Moth. Ghost Line lifted my blackbook — years of outlines in there. They stashed it in the north alley. Get it back and I'll be your lookout.
dialogue.active: The blackbook's still in the north alley, behind Ghost Line's tags. Watch yourself in there.
dialogue.recovered: You actually got it back. Okay — you paint, I watch. I'm in your crew.
dialogue.recruited: Eyes open. I'll whistle if security loops close or anyone creeps on your walls.

name: Rico
bonusDescription: Assists murals and auto-fills throw-ups on open walls in claimed territory.
hint: Sketching fat letters by the loading dock.
missionDescription: Recover his cap case from the train siding.

dialogue.meet: Call me Caps. City's sitting on my cap case by the train siding. Get that back and I'll fatten your fills wherever you hold ground.
dialogue.active: My caps are still out by the siding. Chrome boys won't use 'em right anyway.
dialogue.recovered: That's the case. Say less — your walls need weight, and I got the hand for it.
dialogue.recruited: Point me at a held block and I'll make the empty spots look claimed.

name: Jay
bonusDescription: Calls one free escape per heat level before security can dock your rep or paint.
hint: Leans on the footbridge, listening for patrol radios.
missionDescription: Recover his transit scanner from the south alley.

dialogue.meet: Metro. I run shortcuts by sound. My scanner's in the south alley — bring it back and I'll pull you out when heat turns ugly.
dialogue.active: Scanner's still south alley. Without it, I'm guessing at sirens like everybody else.
dialogue.recovered: That's my scanner. Now when heat jumps, I can hear the gap before security closes it.
dialogue.recruited: Keep moving. I got one clean route per heat level before they learn it.

name: Nia
bonusDescription: Cuts Lupe's shop prices by 10% and finds better-paying delivery routes.
hint: Counts cans near the north alley stash door.
missionDescription: Recover her route ledger from behind the corner block.

dialogue.meet: Stash. I know every back-door paint hookup in this ward, but my route ledger got lifted behind the corner block. Bring it back and I'll make your supply runs lighter.
dialogue.active: Ledger's still behind the corner block. Without it, Lupe's paying regular prices and everybody's guessing at routes.
dialogue.recovered: That's the ledger. Good. I can shave prices and steer you toward runs that actually pay.
dialogue.recruited: Check Lupe's board. I marked the routes that don't waste your night.

name: Tali
bonusDescription: Pulls bigger reactions from locals and boosts nightclub set payouts by 5%.
hint: Runs stickers and flyers near the canal underpass.
missionDescription: Recover her flyer roll from the canal underpass.

dialogue.meet: Echo. I can make a quiet wall feel like everybody saw it. My flyer roll vanished under the canal pass — get it back and I'll put eyes on your work.
dialogue.active: Flyer roll's still under the canal pass. Without it, I'm shouting with empty hands.
dialogue.recovered: There it is. Now give me something worth yelling about and I'll make the block look twice.
dialogue.recruited: Paint loud. I'll make sure the room hears it.

name: Vale
bonusDescription: Softens caught penalties and slows cleanup sweeps against your walls.
hint: Waits by the service gate with a pocket full of favors.
missionDescription: Recover their city-service pass from the rooftop stairwell.

dialogue.meet: Fix. I can make a bad stop cost less and a cleanup truck arrive late. My city-service pass is up by the rooftop stairs. Bring it back and I'll owe you.
dialogue.active: Pass is still by the rooftop stairs. Without it, every favor costs double.
dialogue.recovered: That's the pass. Good. Next time security gets hands on you, it won't bite as deep.
dialogue.recruited: Keep your head down. I know who to call when the city starts buffing.

name: Inez
bonusDescription: Coaches rival wall duels, raising answer rewards and crew standing when you take a callout back.
hint: Studies rival hands by the Canal Side dry dock.
missionDescription: Recover her battle notes from the old train yard.

dialogue.meet: Clash. I read the way crews answer a wall. My battle notes are out by the old train yard. Bring them back and I'll help you turn callouts into wins.
dialogue.active: Notes are still at the old train yard. Without them, you're answering rivals blind.
dialogue.recovered: That's the book. Good. Next callout, we make the whole crew feel it.
dialogue.recruited: Don't just paint back. Answer clean, answer loud, and make them remember who held the wall.
